newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TEN-MAN SAMPDORIA FIGHT BACK TO BEAT MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEN-MAN SAMPDORIA FIGHT BACK TO BEAT MILAN.

text.p: Marco Carparelli scored a dramatic late winner as ten-man Sampdoria came from 2-1 down to defeat champions A.C.Milan 3-2 at the San Siro on Sunday and firmly establish themselves as Italian title contenders.
Victory leaves second-placed Sampdoria with 35 points from 19 matches, just two adrift of leaders Juventus, held 0-0 at Cagliari.
The Genoa side played most of the match without regular goalkeeper Fabrizio Ferron, shown the red card in the 23rd minute for pulling down George Weah.

The 20-year-old Carparelli's goal completed a spirited fight-back from Samp who had taken a surprise first minute lead through Roberto Mancini, before falling behind to a double strike from Liberia's Weah, back from a 42-day injury lay-off.
